verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only the server role. Capacities exposes its space over MCP so that external clients (ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Le Chat, or custom MCP clients) can connect to it. Nothing documents Capacities' own AI assistant connecting to or consuming tools from external MCP servers. Exposing an MCP server is a different capability from acting as an MCP client, so it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
